orderCode.description: Unique identifier of the order on the ecommerce.

details[].orderDetailCode.description: The ID on your system for the customized-product line item.

total.description: The total order amount in the base currency set in Zakeke API settings.

details.example: At least one customized line item when the order contains designs.

details[].sku.description: Unique identifier that the ordered customized product has in ecommerce.

details[].designId.description: Unique design identifier provided by Zakeke.

details[].modelUnitPrice.description: Product unit price without the design price.

details[].designModificationId.description: Identifier assigned by Zakeke for a specific Names and Numbers or bulk-variation instance.

compositionDetails[].orderDetailCode.description: The ID on your system for the configured-product line item.

compositionDetails.example: Configured-product line items when the order contains compositions.

compositionDetails[].compositionId.description: The product configuration identifier for the configured product that the line item belongs to.

compositionDetails[].unitPrice.description: The unit price of the configured product including configuration price after discounts.

compositionDetails[].quantity.description: The number of configured products that were purchased.
